db_name.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database where pgagent stores its metadata (e.g., job definitions, history).

db_host.description: Host name or IP address of the PostgreSQL server.

db_port.description: Port number on which PostgreSQL is listening.

db_user.description: Database user account for pgagent to connect with. Must have permissions to access the pgagent schema and tables.

db_password.description: Password for the database user. Leave empty if not needed (e.g., peer/ident auth, or using .pgpass).

db_sslmode.description: SSL mode for database connection. Use values like 'disable', 'allow', 'prefer', 'require', 'verify-ca', or 'verify-full'. Empty means use driver default.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 0 (ERROR), 1 (WARNING), 2 (DEBUG). Higher values log more details. Note: official docs use 0,1,2 (ERROR, WARNING, DEBUG); template's 0-4 is incorrect.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. If empty or '-', logs are written to standard output (e.g., systemd journal).

pid_file.description: Full path to the PID file used by the pgagent daemon process.

worker_threads.description: Number of concurrent job worker threads. Adjust based on expected job concurrency and system resources.

hostname.description: Custom hostname to identify this agent instance. Useful in multi-agent environments. If empty, system hostname is used.

daemonize.description: Run pgagent as a background daemon. Set to false for foreground execution (e.g., under systemd with Type=simple).

poll_interval.description: Poll time interval in seconds for job checking (default 10). Maps to -t option in man page.

conn_timeout.description: Idle connection timeout in seconds. Connections unused longer than this are closed and reopened.

retry_period.description: Retry period in seconds after connection abort (>=10, default 30). Maps to -r option in man page.

removed.description: Use 'poll_interval' instead; typE is not documented and was likely a typo for poll cycle (POLLCYCLE).
